description: Is it safe to pay this address? The address-only version of /check: OFAC SDN sanctions screen, wallet age, EOA or contract, first funder and recent large transfers on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon (wallet kind and activity on Solana), with the funder and counterparties screened too. Returns ok, caution or block with plain reasons. No token score (use /check for that). Rules-based, not legal advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: Address you are about to pay or receive from

chain.description: Chain of the payment; defaults to solana for base58 addresses, otherwise base

expect.description: What the address should be: eoa (a wallet), contract, or any (default); a mismatch gives caution

name: prepayment_safety_check_lite
